quotes.author: Crystal Crawford
quotes.text: Crystal Crawford13:21 05 Jun 24I live in Mt Pleasant...and am a memeber of the boat club, but wanted to give my son the best fishing experience by hiring a professional who really knew the waters. Hiring Jason at Charleston Fishing Trips was the best decision. Not only did we catch several types of fish the entire trip, he is a salt of the earth type of guy. Big bonus points: we caught a 42 in red fish, which can be very fragile to put back successfully, he taught us how to handle their float bladder on re-entry to the water so they survive. He also fillet'd our sea bass. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

quotes.author: Mark Stewart
quotes.text: Mark Stewart16:30 02 Oct 24I had my father visiting from out of town and wanted to make sure to get him out with someone who could definitely show him a great day and Captain Jason Davis did exactly that. We had a fantastic early morning catching reds, blacks, trout, sheepshead and a whole bunch more and then shifted gears later in the tide and went after some big bull reds. We caught another 10 or 12 of those and were happy as could be! Jason is a safe and knowledgeable Captain and he's also a super fun guy to hang out with for the day. Can't wait to get back out there with him!

quotes.author: Robert Hervieux
quotes.text: Robert Hervieux00:15 06 Jun 246/5/24 My daughter and I had an action filled afternoon of fishing with guide Jason Davis. We encountered several species using a few different techniques. Jason has quality equipment and years of experience. I highly recommend Charleston fishing trips to anyone at any skill level. We can’t wait to book our next trip! Thanks again Captain Davis for a memorable experience! -Robert

quotes.author: Read Roberts
quotes.text: Read Roberts12:31 20 Sep 24My family of 5 had one of the best days of our lives on a fishing trip with Jason in August. He knows the area and it worked perfectly for me, my wife, and kids age 12-17. We caught all types of fish , and even sharks(!) while enjoying all the beautiful sights. We talk about this trip all the time, can’t recommend enough. Thanks Captain Jason and Charleston Fishing Trips!

quotes.author: Kevin Madden
quotes.text: Kevin Madden19:46 16 Jun 24I have been out with Jason several times over the years. He always provides a great experience. Regardless of weather and tides he provides a new experience and a great time on the water. This last trip we had about 7-8 keepers and a great dinner that night! If you're trying to decide whether or not to book him, just do it, you won't be disappointed.

quotes.author: Brooke Hervieux
quotes.text: Brooke Hervieux00:29 06 Jun 24Jason is full of knowledge and knows all the nooks and cranny’s for catching all the creatures. This was the best fishing trip I have ever been on. He connects with the people who aboard his boat and makes sure they are taken care of and are provided a very memorable experience, and is a very fun person to be around!!!
